record.question: According to Faraday's Laws of Electromagnetic Induction, an emf is induced in a conductor whenever it
options: moves parallel to the direction of the magnetic field
lies perpendicular to the magnetic flux
record.explanation: Faraday's law states that EMF is induced only when a conductor cuts through magnetic field lines. Motion parallel or lying stationary in a field produces no induction.
